## Screenshots

<!-- For web UI changes, attach the affected pages before/after. -->

Run `yarn screenshots` to regenerate `docs/screenshots/*.png` and commit the result; CI renders the same pages with `yarn screenshots:check` and fails when a committed image no longer matches. The **screenshots** artifact on this workflow run has every page freshly rendered plus pixel diffs, so you can download the images from there instead of running it locally.
